response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT p.fundflux FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref), grp AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM joined GROUP BY fundflux), tot AS (SELECT SUM(qc_count) AS total_qc, AVG(qc_count) AS avg_per_group FROM grp) SELECT g.fundflux, g.qc_count, g.qc_count * 1.0 / t.total_qc AS share_of_total, g.qc_count * 1.0 / t.avg_per_group AS ratio_to_average FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot t ORDER BY g.qc_count DESC, g.fundflux

assumptions.assumption: Only NULL fundflux counts as missing. Empty or whitespace-only strings are kept as their own separate group. The SQL is written for a PostgreSQL-style dialect, where the inner join drops QC records without a matching project.
The average per funding source is the mean of the per-group QC counts (total QC records divided by the number of funding-source groups, including the missing-source group).

alternatives.interpretation: Treat blank or whitespace-only funding sources as missing, so they merge into the same group as NULL.
alternatives.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(p.fundflux), '') AS fundflux FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref), grp AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM joined GROUP BY fundflux), tot AS (SELECT SUM(qc_count) AS total_qc, AVG(qc_count) AS avg_per_group FROM grp) SELECT g.fundflux, g.qc_count, g.qc_count * 1.0 / t.total_qc AS share_of_total, g.qc_count * 1.0 / t.avg_per_group AS ratio_to_average FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot t ORDER BY g.qc_count DESC, g.fundflux
